M-KERNEL-CAPABILITY-RUNTIME.Summary: Generic Rust microkernel boundary for plugin definitions and installations, runtime lifecycle, capability discovery and authorization, RPC, independent typed events, state ownership, effects, security, and trajectory evidence.

M-REFERENCE-PROVING-SLICE.Summary: Replaceable browser-like, agent-like, and UI-like reference plugins plus the permanent S0 and S1 host-level proving path through only public kernel contracts.

M-GRACE-CONTROL-LAYER.Summary: Repository-local GRACE 4 workflow model, immutable change contracts, scope controls, verification projection, evidence language, and acceptance protocol.

M-CI-BASELINE.Summary: Repository-owned CI entrypoint and thin pull-request/master orchestration for source, correctness, architecture-security, and permanent S0/S1 proving-slice gates.

M-PERSISTENCE-RECOVERY.Summary: Production persistence and recovery boundary: generic kernel contracts, SQLite StateBackend, transactional outbox, durable EventJournal, selective audit, CAS blobs, persistent jobs, online backup/restore, hard-kill recovery evidence, and production-backed S1.
